stories.title: Dean’s Note: Future-Proofing LSA Students
stories.summary: Dean Ceballo writes that our world is changing rapidly, and new careers are emerging in the blink of an eye. LSA graduates will always be ready.

stories.title: Less Waste, Zero Regrets
stories.summary: LSA professors, students, and staff are finding innovative ways to increase sustainability in classroom and lab practices, reduce waste, and impact science education’s environmental footprint. Where to begin? By looking at their own two feet.

stories.title: A Living Language
stories.summary: The language of the Aztecs lives on in words you use every day, among more than a million speakers, and in a class at LSA that teaches far more than just grammar.

stories.title: Seizing the Opportunity
stories.summary: A student finds her passion—and her major—through an Undergraduate Research Opportunity Program experience.

stories.title: The Visible World
stories.summary: Students learn to slow down in order to see clearly in an LSA history of art course.

stories.title: Behind the Scenes at the Smithsonian
stories.summary: We dive into the inner workings of an American institution with an alum and two students, and look at how it’s transforming our understanding of the past.
